title: Saltwater Cycle Party Boat Tours
specs: Two boats: tiki style and cycle boat with pedal bar seats
Must have footwear; closed toe shoes recommended for pedaling
Up to 18 passengers per boat plus captain and deckhand
Can combine both boats for groups larger than 18
includes: Music playlists and Bluetooth sound system on private cruises
Licensed master captain and one deckhand
blurb: Guests can book public or private party boat tours on two boats: a tiki style boat with bar seats and bench seating, and a cycle boat with pedal bar seats and bench seating. Trips last 1 hour and 30 minutes and include water, ice, coolers, music, a licensed captain, and a deckhand. All trips are BYOB and suitable for various celebrations like birthdays, bachelorette parties, and corporate events.
extraNote: Gratuity is additional and can be added online or given in cash
